additional_terms: Dataset card restricts RoyaleAPI/Supercell material to research and personal projects; no official-client equivalence asserted

expert_fact_table.evidence_method: Browser-visible article rank/score/linked account IDs. Full article retained only as ignored local research evidence; committed table contains facts. Direct HTTP returned403 and was not treated as profile evidence.

selection: all complete raw members across the complete pinned archive containing at least one exact historical-top100 account tag; no opponent auto-certification
sampling_limits: Complete fixed November1 snapshot, not the entire live HF repository, and not a random sample; same historical July2026 top100 account evidence as prefix-v1
sensitive_data_review: public in-game account tags/names only; no login, API credentials, private accounts or messages
